title: Obbalu Laila Goskara
desc: After returning from a world tour, a man comes across a woman and falls in love with her. However, she has no interest in him and rejects his proposal.

title: Ananda Nilaya
desc: A man in debt is in desperate need of money and wants to sell a house he has in the city. But first he must deal with a stubborn tenant family that refuses to leave the house despite his best efforts.

title: Snehitharu
desc: A group of four friends set out to rescue a young boy who has been kidnapped. However, soon their incompetence leads them in the wrong direction.

title: Triple Riding
desc: A man falls in love with the daughter of a rich business. However, his life turns into chaos when he pretends to be a doctor to help her friend escape an arranged marriage.
